# Getting Authorized {.unnumbered #sec-getting-started}

All users must be authorized in order to access non-public materials on Databrary.

If you represent an **institution**, see [this section](../authorizing institutions.qmd) for information about how researchers gain access to Databrary via a formal process of institutional authorization.

If you are a **researcher**, see [this section](authorized-researchers.qmd) about how to start the authorization process with your institution.

If you are a **research staff member, postdoc, graduate or undergraduate student**, see [this section](students.qmd) for information about how to gain access to restricted data via your research supervisor. 

Any person may browse and view Databrary's public materials consistent with the [Terms & Conditions of Use](add new .qmd).
